description: This file defines an abstract class 'View' in the SuiteCRM namespace that extends a base View class. It provides methods for rendering templates, configuring global variables and translations for search settings, generating form buttons, and listing search engines. The class is part of the administration search MVC view layer, involved in rendering the search configuration interface.

classes.name: View
classes.description: An abstract class for rendering and configuring the search admin view, handling template assignments, UI button creation, and engine listings.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Sets up global variables and template assignments for rendering the search configuration page.

methods.name: getButtons
methods.description: Returns HTML markup for save and cancel buttons on the configuration form.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns an array mapping engine identifiers to their translated, human-readable labels.
